digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow and test infrastructure
propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13 cells) reached 99% progress then hung for 1.7–4.3 hours without emitting output until manual cancellation, blocking the run queue.

The reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml test job lacks a timeout-minutes configuration, allowing GitHub's 360-minute default to persist; the documented normal execution is 10–16 minutes, creating a 22x margin for manual-clear dependence.

Affected Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 omitted commit 96a0d5c3f (blob refill fix) and retained lazy per-blob fetches during checkout-index, causing git to issue one RPC per missing blob (~2.1 hours for ~25k files).

Change 1129 introduced test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract which infinitely paged through FakeJiraClient.search_issues because the fake ignored startAt/maxResults pagination parameters and returned the same non-empty result set unbounded.

After rebasing 1129 to include the fake-pagination fix and the workflow timeout-minutes: 60 setting, downstream 1130 PS5 completed normally (4–12m per cell) with expected test failures unrelated to hangs.
